title: Jazzy Korean Sausage Bowl
description: A festive, umami-packed bowl that blends smoky Korean pork sausage, tender spinach, and savory bonito flakes for a springy, satisfying lunch.
instructions: Boil the pre-cooked rice according to package instructions if not already cooked, or reheat until steaming.
Cut the Korean pork sausage into bite-sized pieces and sear them in a hot skillet until browned and cooked through, about 5 minutes.
Toss the spinach in the same skillet for 1 minute until just wilted, then remove and set aside.
In a small bowl, whisk together gochujang, soy sauce, and a splash of sesame oil to make the sauce.
Assemble the bowl by placing a generous scoop of rice at the bottom, then topping with the cooked sausage and wilted spinach.
Drizzle the sauce over the ingredients, then sprinkle with sliced scallions, bonito flakes, and sesame seeds.
Gently stir the bowl to combine flavors, keeping the sausage pieces intact for a springy bite.
Serve immediately, optionally adding a raw egg yolk on top for extra richness.
